title.narrative: Railway Energy Efficiency and Safety Enhancement Investment Program - Tranche IV

description.narrative: Tranche 4 of the Investment Program will finance procurement of (i) environmental protection and (ii) railway safety enhancement. The outputs for this tranche are (i) environmental protection which comprises introduction of environmental protection equipment, and (ii) railway safety enhancement which comprises introduction of track safety operation and aintenance equipment, anti-seismic bridge bearings, enhanced railway fasteners, heavy duty switches, and signaling system facilities.

description.narrative: An energy-efficient, safe, reliable, affordable, and environment-friendly railway transport system is developed in the region.

A 20% reduction in rate of accidents per billion traffic by 2020 from 2008 Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: Postevaluation surveys and reports from CRC Actual value:
CO2 emissions are reduced by 22,106 tons in 2020. Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: Postevaluation surveys and reports from CRC Actual value:
Fuel savings increased by CNY936 million in 2020. Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: Postevaluation surveys and reports from CRC Actual value:

Transport capacity expanded in the southwestern PRC to 150 billion passenger-km for passengers in 2020 Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: Progress reports Actual value:
Transport capacity expanded in the southwestern PRC to 470 billion ton-km for freight in 2020 Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: Progress reports Actual value:
